subject: Medullosa erect massive multi-order frond seed plant
factual_scope: One erect self-supporting medullosan whole-habit hypothesis, not universal for Medullosa. Wilson et al2015 Figure6A depicts a Pennsylvania compression-fossil-based erect interpretation, while6B and Wilson/Fischer2011 demonstrate different/lax habits. Original Alberta specimen images corroborate stem and pinna preservation, not a complete fossil tree. Nominal height, module counts, colors and detailed frond outline artistic.
identifying_features: One self-standing limited relatively slender stem with twelve sparse persistent petiole stubs, quiet bare intervals, and six substantial frond petioles. No continuous pineapple-like scale armor or broad buttress root cage.

Each very large frond divides into two fan arms, each with four pinnae carrying eight elongate rounded pinnules:384 pinnules total. Strong multi-order compound hierarchy and broad spatially spread fans, not a cycad single-pinnate crown.
Fronds arch outward in different azimuths and elevations. Vegetative educational whole plant: no disputed reproductive structures, flowers, fruit, or extra species.
